purpose: Repair the fail-closed handoff from a successful owner exact-SHA web release to Platform V7/Gekta production mobile acceptance. The workflow_run trigger is already restricted to canonical release workflows; successful release events must enter the accepted-SHA resolver, which independently proves deployment evidence and the live manifest before browser acceptance can run.
forbiddenChanges: model runtime, prompt, inference routing or latency experiments
agro-chat API or attachment backend contracts
PC-CROP registration, reviewer, MFA or password-reset runtime
role, tenant, RBAC, RLS or PostgreSQL authority
production credentials or direct REG.RU mutation
paid external services or new infrastructure
maturityBoundary: This scope repairs release-to-acceptance orchestration only and does not attest product capabilities until the existing production Playwright suite passes against an exact deployed SHA.
